Verification Step: 1. Open Pat1 > Payment Plan > Plan1 and launch the Agreement preview. 2. Scroll to the Terms & Conditions section. 3. Locate the Manual Payments clause. 4. Assert it states that a separate manual payment will NOT automatically stop, reduce or delay the next scheduled automatic payment. 5. Assert the clause is present in the default template for every plan (re-check on a second plan Plan2 of another patient Pat2). 6. Confirm the clause is readable in the printed/PDF copy of the Agreement as well.
Status Comment: Agreement manual-payments clause.

Description:
Agreement Terms: failed payments may be re-attempted within 30 calendar days, possibly with a returned-payment fee. 
- Read the Failed Payments clause.
Pre-requisite Data: Pat1 = patient with saved payment plan Plan1 using card Card1; Agreement available for Plan1; Tpl1 = default Payment Plan Agreement template.
Test Data: Any plan.
Expected Output: The Failed Payments clause states a declined charge may be re-attempted within 30 calendar days and a returned payment fee may be added to the second attempt, as permitted by the plan terms.
Verification Step: 1. Open Pat1 > Payment Plan > Plan1 and launch the Agreement preview. 2. Scroll to Terms & Conditions and find the Failed Payments clause. 3. Assert the clause states a declined charge may be re-attempted within 30 calendar days. 4. Assert the clause states a returned-payment fee may be added to the second attempt as permitted by the plan terms. 5. Assert the 30-day wording is fixed template text and does not change with the plan frequency. 6. Confirm the same clause appears on the Agreement of a second plan Plan2 to prove it comes from the default template.
Status Comment: Agreement failed-payments clause. Not finalized.

Description:
Agreement Cancellation Policy requires at least 3 business days' notice before the payment date.
- Read the Cancellation Policy.
Pre-requisite Data: Pat1 = patient with saved payment plan Plan1 that has an End Date End1; Agreement available for Plan1; Tpl1 = default Payment Plan Agreement template.
Test Data: Any plan.
Expected Output: The Cancellation Policy states the authorization remains until the total is paid, the end date is reached, or the patient cancels, and that at least 3 business days' notice before the payment date is required to avoid the next charge.
Verification Step: 1. Open Pat1 > Payment Plan > Plan1 and launch the Agreement preview. 2. Scroll to the Cancellation Policy section. 3. Assert it states the authorization stays in force until the total is paid, the end date is reached, or the patient cancels. 4. Assert it states at least 3 business days notice before the payment date is required to avoid the next charge. 5. Assert the notice period reads "business days" (not calendar days). 6. Re-open the Agreement on a plan without an end date and confirm the Cancellation Policy wording is still present.
Status Comment: Agreement cancellation clause.

Description:
Agreement "Agree & Continue" is the execution/authorization step that activates the plan.
- Read the Execution & Authorization section.
- Tick "Agree & Continue".
Pre-requisite Data: Pat1 = patient with a newly saved payment plan Plan1 awaiting agreement; client setting "Show Agreement on Payment Plan" = Yes & keep it mandatory; Agreement window opens after Save.
Test Data: A plan awaiting agreement.
Expected Output: Ticking "Agree & Continue" records the patient's authorization to the automatic payment terms and electronic communications consent, and (per the client setting) activates the plan.
Verification Step: 1. Open Pat1 > Payment Plan, create/save Plan1 so the Agreement window opens. 2. Scroll to the Execution & Authorization section and read the authorization wording. 3. Tick / click "Agree & Continue". 4. Assert the system records the patient authorization (the Agreement now shows as agreed with date/time stamp or signature). 5. Re-open Plan1 and assert its status is Active because the agreement was accepted. 6. Assert the electronic communications consent is recorded together with the authorization. 7. Negative check: repeat on a second plan Plan2, close the window without agreeing, and confirm the plan is saved but left Inactive.
Status Comment:
"Description: replace with:
""Agreement 'Agree & Continue' records authorization; for a mandatory agreement it is required before the saved plan can become Active.""

Expected Output: replace with:
""Agree & Continue records authorization. When client setting = Yes & Keep it mandatory, closing without agreement leaves the saved plan Inactive; agreeing allows it to become Active.""

Verification Step: replace with:
""1. Set Show Agreement on Payment Plan = Yes & Keep it mandatory. 2. Save a new plan. 3. Close Agreement without agreeing and assert plan is saved Inactive. 4. Reopen Agreement and click Agree & Continue. 5. Assert authorization is recorded and plan becomes Active.""
